returns.start: Email support@fieldnote.store with your order number to start a return.
returns.refund_timing: After the return is received and inspected, refunds go to the original payment method. Banks may take 5–10 business days to post them.
returns.exceptions: Damaged, incorrect, or personalized items need a support specialist to review the order.

shipping.processing: Orders are packed within 1–2 business days.
shipping.transit: US delivery usually takes 3–5 business days after dispatch.
shipping.tracking: A tracking link is emailed when the parcel is dispatched.

orders.status: Order-specific status must be checked in the store system. If no live order lookup is connected, ask for the order number and leave the message for a person.
